title: Throughput Lattice: Compact Sparkstrip & Token Pulse Specs for Per-Model/Route Dashboard
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a compact, scannable dashboard row (Throughput Lattice) that surfaces per-route and per-model performance signals — latency distributions, throughput bands, and token-level pulse — optimized for console briefings and small-screen panes.
goals: Provide a single-row compact summary that scales to 20+ routes in a table view
Enable fast triage: identify high-cost and high-latency routes with 2 visual cues
Expose token flow anomalies (spikes in prompt or generation tokens) inline without expanding a modal
success_metrics: Reduction in mean time-to-identify (MTTI) for perf incidents by 30% in user testing
>70% of users can read token spike and throughput shift within 3s of glance in usability test
No more than 12px height increase per table row vs current baseline
constraints: Must live inside existing per-route table cell (width variable) without reflowing surrounding columns
Use existing color tokens for severity (ok/warn/critical) and avoid adding new semantic colors
Should be implementable with Chart.js / D3 primitives used by frontend team (no custom WebGL)
Accessible: meets AA contrast and has screen-reader text summaries for each compact chart
design_artifacts: Spec doc: Confluence - Throughput Lattice & Token Pulse Design Specs
wireframes: compact-row-0: shows throughput sparkstrip (3 bands) + latency violin thumbnail + token pulse microbar
compact-row-1: alternative with stacked microcharts for narrow widths
expanded-quickview: on hover/expand shows full latency distribution, token waterfall, and cost delta
chart_specs: Throughput Sparkstrip: 120x18px inline sparkline aggregated to 1s buckets, color bands = 3 quantiles (p50/p95/p99) with band opacity 0.18/0.28/0.42
Latency Mini-violin: 72x18px symmetric kernel-density thumbnail for response latency (ms) with overlayed median marker (6px tall) and p95 line
Token Pulse: 120x12px microbar showing prompt vs gen token ratio by minute; stacked bars with hover tooltip for numeric counts
Interaction: hover on any micro-chart triggers quickview panel with full charts and deep-links to route timeline
prototyping_notes: Built prototype using Figma interactive components and exported to user-testing harness
Simulated data sets with pathological cases: bursty throughput, long-tail latency, token blowouts (input size > 50k tokens)
Performance note: avoid rendering >200 inline svgs on page load; use canvas tilt for large tables
Accessibility: added aria-label summaries like 'Latency median 120ms, p95 980ms; Token gen spike +42%'
review_comments: PM (Priya Nair): prefer explicit numeric delta for cost impact next to sparkstrip (small text) — Marcus to evaluate spacing
Eng (Diego Morales): micro-violins OK but canvas required for >500 rows to avoid reflow; will add perf budget
Design lead (Riley Carter): simplify color gradation — remove a fourth severity color to keep palette consistent
Accessibility (Jordan Kim): request SR summary strings be included in rendered DOM for screen readers
engineering_feedback: Frontend (Marcus Lee): will implement Sparkstrip as lightweight canvas draw; needs exact bucket algorithm (we specified 1s buckets)
Backend (Sofia Patel): can provide p50/p95/p99 pre-aggregates and token counts for last 15m window; need API field names
Observability (Liam O'Connor): suggest adding trace id drilldown link when p95 crosses threshold
decisions: Ship compact row as default for per-route table; provide toggle to switch to stacked microcharts for narrow screens
Use kernel-density violin thumbnail for latency; if backend cannot provide KDE, fallback to boxplot silhouette
Limit inline token pulse retention to 15 minutes of 1-second buckets to bound rendering cost
Expose cost delta as a micro-text facet next to sparkstrip (signed green/red) with hover for breakdown
open_risks: Rendering perf on large org pages (500+ routes) — may require server-side pre-rendering or virtualization
Data fidelity: backend must provide consistent bucket alignment across metrics else sparkstrip vs token pulse misalign
Small width cases (<320px) lose mini-violin legibility — need to define cutover to stacked layout
next_steps: Finalize API contract with Observability team (fields, bucket size, window) — target 2026-03-16
Design handoff package: export tokens, component variants, and interactive prototype to the frontend guild — 2026-03-17
Run 5 moderated usability sessions with N=10 console users focusing on triage speed — schedule by 2026-03-19
Create engineering spike to measure canvas vs svg perf for 200/500/1000 rows — assigned to Marcus Lee
